name: social
title: Social
summary: People get a public profile with a handle, bio and links, follow each other, choose who sees each part of their profile, and read what the people they follow did.

env.name: SOCIAL_HANDLE_COOLDOWN
env.doc: Shortest time between two handle changes by one person (0 = any time).

env.name: SOCIAL_HANDLE_REDIRECT
env.doc: How long an old handle keeps redirecting to the new one; nobody else can take it meanwhile. Also how long a deleted account's handle stays unclaimable.

env.name: SOCIAL_RESERVED_HANDLES
env.doc: Comma-separated handles nobody can take, on top of the built-in list (routes, staff words, the app's name).

env.name: SOCIAL_MAX_FOLLOWING
env.doc: Most people one person can follow.

env.name: SOCIAL_ACTIVITY_RETENTION
env.doc: Activity items older than this are deleted (at least 24h).

wire.insert: import { socialAccountMenu, socialHomeTile, socialNav, socialSettings } from "./social/registry";

stitch: Record activity from your modules: social.RegisterKind (with a Render that builds title, summary and link from data) and social.RegisterSection for any part of a profile people should control, both in the module's New; then social.Record(ctx, tx, social.Activity{…}) where the thing happens and social.RemoveActivity when it is deleted. A module that doesn't require social does this from backend/internal/api/stitch_social.go.
Show people by handle elsewhere: social.Refs(ctx, q, ids) on the server, and link names and avatars to /u/<handle> (FollowButton and PersonRow are exported from @/features/social on web and mobile).
Decide the handle rules: add brand and product words to SOCIAL_RESERVED_HANDLES; set SOCIAL_HANDLE_COOLDOWN and SOCIAL_HANDLE_REDIRECT.

Place the entries: web nav Following, Home tile People, account menu Your profile, Settings → Public profile; mobile Following tab, Home row People, two Settings rows. Move or drop them in the registries.
Profiles are visible to signed-in people only. To serve them signed out, add a PublicRoutes route that calls the profile builder with uuid.Nil (public sections only) and a page under (public).
Add social to the privacy policy and store data-safety forms: public profile (handle, bio, links), who people follow, activity shown to followers; follow notifications go through notifications.
